name: Design-system foundation reveal
purpose: Borrow credibility from the open-source design system underneath the product, by revealing its mark as the reader scrolls into it.

header.note: The ONLY section that ships a titleMobile variant.

logoLayers.note: stroke / main / blender layers of a real third-party design system's mark. Compliance-critical — see assets/asset-roles.json.

geometry.radarCorrection: CLONE_SPEC's 367x367 is the radar file's INTRINSIC size. The rendered box is 292x292.

scrub.bandTopNote: T0 is a CONSTANT 1080.5 (measured 1080.44 at vh=900 and 1080.5 at vh=700), so it does NOT track viewport height. The earlier (vh + 180) form was a coincidence at vh=900 and was 200px off at vh=700.
scrub.spanNote: D is WIDTH-dependent: 539 at >=1200px, 471.5 below. Both measured widths sit either side of the 1200px breakpoint at which the logo stack itself steps size. Only two widths were measured, so the MECHANISM is inferred; the two values are not.
scrub.dampingNote: Only the TRANSFORM is damped (lerp 0.0745, settles over 67 frames). On a 480px scroll jump the blender's opacity was already at its final 0.891466 on the FIRST rAF and held for 90 frames with transition-duration 0s, while translateY on the same element took 67 frames. Deriving both from one damped channel made the blender fade lag scroll by ~650ms.
scrub.performanceGate: An IntersectionObserver with rootMargin '800px 0px 800px 0px' gates the rAF loop. It is NOT the trigger — the trigger is the clamp. A bare threshold:0 observer would leave the layers frozen, because the band starts below the fold.
scrub.verification: At vh=900: rect.top 1000 -> p 0.1484 -> translateY 85.16 (site 85.089), blender 0.1484 (site 0.149351); rect.top 700 -> p 0.7050 -> translateY 29.50 (site 29.4365), lines 0.7950 (site 0.794063).

motion.supersedes: CLONE_SPEC 3.4's 'no scroll-linked (scrubbed) animation anywhere' is wrong for this section.
motion.preRevealState: translateY(100px) with the blender fully transparent. The inline values in a static capture are just the settled END of the scrub.
